### A Message from Isaiah
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-october-15-11582940.html
Passage: Isaiah 45:2-3
Points:
- God speaks directly and intimately to believers through the promises of Scripture.
- The Lord goes before His people to clear obstacles and break spiritual strongholds.
- Believers can actively pray God's promises back to Him to experience true freedom.
- Trusting the only true God uncovers spiritual riches even in dark or difficult seasons.
